basis_note: All figures Solo/Standalone basis — IFIC's own "Key Financial Data and Indicators" tables are Bank-only. Each year is taken from that year's own annual report; see quarterly/*.json period_note for the restatements later reports make to these figures. Q1-Q3 interim periods (added 2026-08-26) are sourced from IFIC's own unaudited quarterly/half-yearly financial statements (Condensed Separate Balance Sheet / Profit and Loss Account), not the annual report; see each quarter's own quarterly/<FY>_<Q>.json period_note and bank_financials/IFIC/sources.json for exact provenance, OCR/recovery caveats (FY2017 Q1, FY2023 Q1, FY2026 Q1), and why several ratio fields (CAR, Tier-1, NPL, provision coverage, NAV/market price) are null at quarterly granularity.

provision_coverage_pct.note: Provision held against loans as a percentage of classified loans. IFIC prints a single 'Provision for loans and advances' line in most years rather than splitting specific and general provision, so this is total loan-loss provision cover of NPLs, not a pure specific-provision ratio.

roa_pct.note: As reported by the bank, computed on AVERAGE total assets.

roe_pct.note: As reported by the bank, computed on AVERAGE shareholders equity.

roa_pct_period_end.note: Recomputed on period-end total assets for cross-bank comparability; differs from the bank-reported average-balance RoA.

roe_pct_period_end.note: Recomputed on period-end equity for cross-bank comparability; differs from the bank-reported average-balance RoE.

nim_pct_period_end.note: Net interest income over period-end interest-earning assets.

price_to_book.note: Year-end DSE market price divided by net asset value per share.
